newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-England A beat South Australia by six wickets.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-England A beat South Australia by six wickets.

text.p: England A beat South Australia by six wickets in a limited overs match on Wednesday.
England A reached 204 for four in the 45th over of their innings after earlier restricting South Australia to 203 for seven from 50 overs.
Opening batsman Mark Butcher set up the win for England A with an innings of 76.
England A were beaten by nine wickets by a New South Wales second XI in a four-day match in Tamworth last week.
